text.autoconfig.ignoring.title: Ignoring Config
text.autoconfig.ignoring.option.ignoreSp: Remove trailing special characters (Apply to all)
text.autoconfig.ignoring.option.ignoreCh: Toggle ignoring chat from blocked players.
text.autoconfig.ignoring.option.ignoreNa: Hides floating name plates that show an ignored player's name. For servers that draw their own name plates as separate entities instead of using the vanilla name tag. Uses the ignore list only, never Ignoring Everyone.
text.autoconfig.ignoring.option.ignorePa: Drops particles that land within three blocks of an ignored player, for plugins that give players particle effects. Anything else happening that close to them is dropped too.
text.autoconfig.ignoring.option.muteVoic: Sets ignored players to 0% in Simple Voice Chat, and back to 100% once they leave the ignore list. Only touches players muted this way, never a volume you set by hand. Does nothing without Simple Voice Chat installed.
text.autoconfig.ignoring.option.ignoreTa: Toggle display of blocked players on the tablist.
text.autoconfig.ignoring.option.transpar: How visible ignored players stay. 255 leaves them unchanged, 0 hides them completely.
text.autoconfig.ignoring.option.interact: Allows clicking blocks/entities behind ignored players.
§cWarning! Use this feature at your own risk. Make sure to follow the server rules.
text.autoconfig.ignoring.option.ignoreEv: Ignore all players on the server
text.autoconfig.ignoring.option.ignoreSp: Removes trailing special characters from all chat
text.ignoring.command.help.togglenamepla: Toggle hiding server drawn name plates
text.ignoring.command.help.toggleparticl: Toggle hiding particles around ignored players
text.ignoring.command.help.togglevoicech: Toggle muting ignored players in Simple Voice Chat
text.ignoring.command.help.debugchat: Log incoming chat to the log file for diagnosis
text.ignoring.command.debug.chat.hint: Incoming chat is now written to logs/latest.log. Send a public message and have someone whisper you, then turn this off again.
text.ignoring.command.addignore.duplicat: Player '%s' is already in the ignore list
text.ignoring.command.removeignore.notfo: Player '%s' is not in the ignore list
text.ignoring.command.togglevoicechat.mi: Simple Voice Chat is not installed, so this will not do anything yet.
